title: feat: update Grok 4.5 to 4.6
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces canonical `grok-4.5` with `grok-4.6`; preserves `grok-4.5` and `grok-4-5` as compatibility aliases.
- Routes OpenRouter `x-ai/grok-4.6` only through `xai/zdr` with provider fallback disabled; current upstream is `x-ai/grok-4.6-20260810`.
- Updates cached-token pricing to $0.50/M below 200K and $1/M at 200K+, with multiplier 1 and paid-only access unchanged.
- Keeps modalities, endpoints, capabilities, context, description, logo, and Pollinations fallback unchanged.

Verified: direct and local text, vision, streaming, tools, JSON, four reasoning levels, aliases, permissions, cache, exact billing, errors, and a 5-request burst; focused tests and both typechecks pass.

gist.headline: Grok gets fresh pollen
gist.blurb: Grok 4.6 has moved into the garden, while the old 4.5 signposts still lead visitors home. Same toolkit, newer brain, fewer migration rituals.
gist.summary: Replaced the canonical Grok model with `grok-4.6`, routed OpenRouter requests exclusively through `xai/zdr`, and retained `grok-4.5` plus `grok-4-5` as compatibility aliases with updated cached-token pricing.
gist.impact: Text, vision, streaming, tools, JSON, and reasoning requests now use Grok 4.6 without changing existing 4.5 integrations, while cached tokens cost $0.50/M below 200K tokens and $1/M at 200K+.

A retro terminal glows with a simple model-routing diagram, surrounded by blooming code-plants to represent unchanged API capabilities and smooth compatibility.
